name: lower-allocation-threshold
rationale: src/config.rs's default allocation_threshold is 0.15 — a rebalance only fires once the sticky-target vs. current-allocation delta exceeds 15 percentage points. This is a variable independent of indicator warmup (see shorter-hourly-indicator-periods.json's rationale for that separate structural issue), so it is worth isolating on its own: even once compute_btc_target starts producing directional signals, a 15pp gate may be suppressing legitimate rebalances that a lower, still dust-order-safe threshold (0.05, well above allocation_delta_to_order's 0.001 BTC min_order_size floor at typical BTC/JPY prices) would allow through. Testing this change alone, with every indicator period left at default, isolates whether the threshold itself is a binding constraint on trade frequency and Sharpe.
